{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "A slot the description says is not needed is not an item: give it worn false. One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note; then items is empty."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black cashmere crewneck sweater, ribbed hem and cuffs, charcoal grey (#36454F), soft wool blend
Wide-leg black wool-blend trousers, relaxed fit tapering to the ankle, jet black (#000000), heavy tweed weave
Leather Chelsea boots, rounded toe, deep midnight blue (#191970), smooth calfskin leather
Minimalist gold-plated chain necklace and small silver hoop earrings, polished metal finish

This outfit works because it balances the relaxed nature of a rock concert with her request for a classic, unflustered aesthetic through dark, high-quality fabrics. The choice of neat formality ensures she looks put-together yet comfortable enough to walk around the club without restriction. Darker tones like charcoal and midnight blue are perfect for autumn evenings under artificial lighting while maintaining a timeless silhouette."}
